subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report access and evidence sharing
messages:
From: Rachel Owens <security@acme-corp.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim Garza <audits@thirdpartyaudit.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report request and vendor form

Hi Kimberly —

We're kicking off Acme's vendor risk assessment for a purchase order in Q3. Can you please provide Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report for the most recent audit period, and confirm whether you can provide a bridge letter if the report period doesn't cover our required window? Details below: 

- Requested deliverable: SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) + Bridge letter (if applicable)
- Audit window we need coverage for: June 1, 2025 - May 31, 2026 (we can confirm)
- Delivery method: secure transfer preferred (S3 presigned link or secure portal)
- Redaction policy: please indicate if customer data is redacted or if a separate NDA is required

I've attached our vendor request form to capture scope details — acme_vendor_request_form.pdf.

Could you confirm timeline (we'd like materials by July 23) and next steps? If you prefer, happy to hop on a 20-min call.

Thanks,
Rachel Owens
Senior InfoSec Manager, Acme Corp
security@acme-corp.com

Attachment: acme_vendor_request_form.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Owens <security@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Tim Garza <audits@thirdpartyaudit.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request and vendor form

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for the note and the vendor form. We're able to share our SOC 2 Type II report and, in cases where the audit period doesn't fully cover a customer's required window, we can provide a bridge letter that explains coverage and any compensating controls. 

Quick outline of what we can provide and next steps:
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF), redacted to remove customer-identifiable data where applicable
- Bridge letter (PDF) that summarizes scope & dates if needed
- Secure delivery via expiring link (S3) or through our secure portal — please confirm preference
- A short list of in-scope infrastructure and services (e.g., AWS prod account IDs, managed database names) — let us know how detailed you need this

Can you confirm the exact audit window you need (you listed June 1, 2025 - May 31, 2026)? If that is final, we'll validate coverage and either send the Type II report or the report + bridge letter. Targeting a delivery by July 22 to give you time for intake.

Cc'ing Rishi (Security) and Vivek (Customer Success / Legal coordination) to help with delivery & redaction.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

From: Tim Garza <audits@thirdpartyaudit.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rachel Owens <security@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2026-07-15T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request and vendor form

Kimberly —

Confirmed audit window for our procurement: June 1, 2025 - May 31, 2026. We'll need the Type II report that covers that window; if Redwood's report period ends earlier, please include a bridge letter documenting how controls operated since the report's period ended. 

A few intake items:
- Please indicate whether any customer-identifiable data would appear in the report (we prefer redacted copies)
- Could you provide a short inventory of in-scope services (cloud accounts, databases, IAM providers) — an itemized list is helpful
- Upload destination: we can accept a secure expiring link or, if easier, an SFTP/S3 upload. We'll confirm the final upload location after you respond.

Attached is our audit scope workbook (acme_audit_scope.xlsx) to help map coverage to our questionnaire. Timeline: materials by July 23 would be ideal; we will review and respond within three business days.

Thanks,
Tim Garza
Senior Auditor, ThirdParty Audit Services
audits@thirdpartyaudit.com

Attachment: acme_audit_scope.xlsx

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Tim Garza <audits@thirdpartyaudit.com>, Rachel Owens <security@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-16T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request and vendor form

Hi Tim / Rachel —

Thanks for confirming the window. Per Kimberly's note, we've prepared the materials and can deliver them securely. Summary of what we're sharing and how: 

What we're providing (attached / links):
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) — redacted for customer data where present
- SOC 2 bridge letter (PDF) that documents coverage and any changes since the report period
- Short in-scope inventory (one-page) mapping to common questionnaire sections
- Secure access: expiring console link + one-time passphrase (link expires in 7 days)

Delivery method: we've uploaded the files to our secure share. For ease of intake, the secure transfer details are in redwood_soc2_typeii_secure_link.txt attached. If you require direct S3 upload credentials or DocuSign transfer, we can accommodate.

Standard canned replies you can use in procurement intake: 
1) Short (for procurement): "Redwood has provided a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter covering controls through May 31, 2026. Files have been shared via a secure, expiring link (see attached). For questions about scope mapping, please contact rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai."

2) Technical (for security reviewers): "Attached is Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) and a bridge letter. In-scope services include: AWS us-west-2 prod account (ids redacted in report), managed RDS cluster (logical name only), and third-party IAM provider (Okta). Full inventory and control mapping available on request."

Attachments in this delivery: redwood_soc2_typeii_bridge_letter.pdf, redwood_soc2_typeii_secure_link.txt, one-pager-in-scope-inventory.pdf

Next steps:
- Please confirm you received the secure link and can download the files.
- If further artifact requests are needed (e.g., control evidence), list them specifically and we'll route to the appropriate owner.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if useful.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_soc2_typeii_bridge_letter.pdf; redwood_soc2_typeii_secure_link.txt; one-pager-in-scope-inventory.pdf
